study: Independent 16-pair Hard10 versus Continuous10 validation in LSTM, TCN, TCN-LSTM
status: analysis and stopping rules fixed before any new training; locally timestamped, not externally registered

common_training.checkpoint_selection: final epoch10 only, validation for monitoring; no early stopping
common_training.pretraining: one existing fixed checkpoint per backbone, shared within pairs
common_training.architecture_precision_dropout_compile: original defaults unchanged; B_LSTM, never B_LSTM_fast

continuous_targetmax10.sampling_and_loss: same preferential sampling and weighted token loss as v53/v54

evaluation.predictor: unchanged frozen three-seed LightGBM Morgan count ensemble
evaluation.identity: non-isomeric canonical SMILES for deduplication and novelty
evaluation.novelty_reference: full fixed RedDB training split for both arms
evaluation.decoding_rng: historical arm-specific SHA256 P3A e/d baseline rules, only training seed substituted; all864 RNG entries fixed before fitting
evaluation.inference: unchanged sampler and precision, ordinary graph only after bitwise native-eager parity on311validation inputs; native eager fallback otherwise
evaluation.aggregation: each metric per1000-attempt cell, unweighted mean of nine cells per training seed; no treating cells or molecules as independent training replicates
evaluation.complete_pool: deduplicate predicted targets across nine cells within each9000-attempt run; retain descriptive count separately

statistics.primary_metric_definition: 100 times number of distinct valid predicted target molecules absent from full30829training reference, divided by1000 attempts in each cell; average nine cells within seed
statistics.unit: matched fine-tuning seed pair within backbone; decoding streams differ between methods
statistics.test: two-sided paired t test for mean difference against zero, fixed a priori
statistics.family: exactly three primary tests, one per backbone
report: mean paired difference in percentage points
statistics.superiority_rule: backbone-specific superiority on primary endpoint only if mean difference>0 and Bonferroni3 adjusted p<.05; equivalent to lower simultaneous CI>0 for nondegenerate differences
statistics.across_backbone_rule: claim superiority in all three backbones only if each of three tests meets its rule; no pooled-backbone rescue or selecting favorable backbones
statistics.planning_reference_note: 1percentage-point improvement was sample-size planning reference, not an assumed outcome and not a separate tested superiority margin; compare observed magnitude and interval to this reference
statistics.secondary: six other original cell metrics and complete9000-pool count, descriptive means, sampleSD, paired differences; no secondary confirmatory p values
statistics.existing_tests: prior3seed exploratory findings and original14/7test corrections remain unchanged, are not pooled into the new16pair primary analyses
statistics.zero_variance: all paired differences exactly zero => t0,p1 and zero-width CI0; constant nonzero difference => flag degenerate variance, no automatic superiority; require review without switching test post hoc
statistics.nonfinite: do not drop or impute invalid primary values; mark final study incomplete for review
statistics.outliers: retain all valid technical runs regardless of outcome; no performance-driven exclusions
statistics.inference_gating: no aggregate primary p values or superiority judgments until all96jobs have valid training,generation,scoring records

stopping_and_failures.stopping: exactly16new seed pairs in each backbone; no significance-based stopping or sample-size extension
stopping_and_failures.technical_failures: record all failures; at most one automatic restart of identical seed and settings; preserve failed-attempt logs; never substitute a seed based on outcome
stopping_and_failures.incomplete: if a pair cannot be completed, no16pair confirmatory conclusion; report missing pair rather than analyzing a selected subset
stopping_and_failures.retry: successful completed training reused if only generation/scoring fails; failed training restarts from original shared pretrained checkpoint, with failed files preserved
stopping_and_failures.resume: skip only integrity-checked complete stages; no retraining a successful run for a preferred outcome

resources.schedule: oneTCNlane plus three recurrent lanes; afterTCNlane ends it can process remaining recurrent runs; paired arm order alternates by seed index

scope_limits: conditional on existing fixed pretraining checkpoints and frozen predictor
predicted target generation performance only, not DFT or electrolyte validation
whole adaptation strategy comparison, no causal attribution to retention alone
same updates do not equalize molecule exposure
excluded: previous outcomes in new primary tests
